title: VibeComfy Demo Scenarios Catalog
description: Schema for the demo scenarios catalog used by the VibeComfy in-app demo picker

source_run_tree.description: Path to the source run tree that produced these scenarios

title.description: Short human-readable title for the scenario

query.description: The user's inquiry that triggered this scenario

description.description: Detailed description of what the scenario demonstrates

category.description: Category/classification of the scenario (e.g., 'image / upscale', 'video / timing')

required_node_packs.description: List of ComfyUI custom node packs required by this scenario

asset.description: Asset bundle filename for this scenario

run_location.description: Location information for the scenario files

run_dir.description: Directory name containing the scenario files

original_ui.description: Filename of the original (broken) UI JSON

candidate_ui.description: Filename of the candidate (repaired) UI JSON

response_json.description: Filename of the fixer's response JSON
